name: Duskroom
summary: A client and money app for an interiors studio, in smoked glass over a warm room
about: A complete client and money app for a small interiors or design studio. Glass panels float over a drawn living room; switch to the dark theme and dusk falls, the sky turns and the floor lamp glows. Inside are clients, projects with palettes and moodboards, an invoice editor with live preview, furniture sourcing with markup, a live time tracker that turns hours into invoices, and a booking calendar.
how: Toggle the theme and watch dusk fall over the room behind the glass; move your pointer for a gentle parallax.
Create an invoice: pick a client, add line items, discount and tax, and see the paper preview update; mark it paid to stamp it.
Start the timer on a project, stop it to log the time, then use Bill unbilled hours to make a draft invoice.
Advance sourced pieces from Quoted to Ordered, Shipped and Delivered, and see your margin add up.
Open a project for its palette, materials and pieces, and move it to the next stage.
Click any day on the calendar to book a site visit, meeting, delivery or install.
